narr: A complex of thunderstorms moved east across southern Illinois during the early morning hours. A few of the storms became severe. The complex of storms occurred along a cold front that extended from the Great Lakes to the mid Mississippi Valley. The storms occurred along the southern fringe of a band of stronger 500 mb winds in a region of weak to moderate instability. Due to moist ground from previous thunderstorms, some roads were flooded.
ev: Several roads in the Broughton area were flooded. Water was at least a foot deep over Illinois Route 142.
lsr: SEVERAL ROADS IN THE BROUGHTON AREA WITH WATER OVER THEM. HWY 142 HAD WATER AT LEAST A FOOT DEEP OVER IT.
